text:
elena: heads up — thinking about a compact play to tie launch posts + a tiny webinar + benchmark narrative into a single seed->activation loop. goal: 3% lift in day-7 activation for new signups via targeted free-credit nudges
maya: love it. whats the minimal experiment?
sam_g: could we do 2 arms: (A) webinar invite + 25 credits + prompt-template vs (B) 50 credits w/o webinar, measure prompt usage and retention
elena: yep that’s the idea. timeline = 2 week experiment, small randomized cohort (n~1.5k). measure: prompt usage rate, avg tokens/day, return within 7 days, conversion to paid trial
tony: creative thought — micro-launch post with a 3-step CTA: join webinar, claim seed credits, try prompt template. one visual + 1 short clip. I can mock 2 variants today
liam: routing question — how do we handle inbound (organic signups) vs webinar registrants? want to ensure we don’t double-credit people
maya: routing plan: webhook route for registrants -> tag as "webinar_reg"; signup flow checks tag and surfaces the 25-credit promo only if not yet claimed. backend can enforce idempotency on promo grant
sam_g: metrics sheet please. can you add a single row for activation definition? propose: activated = ran >=1 prompt with >=50 tokens and returned within 7 days
elena: added a quick spec in the doc: https://redwood-internal/drive/marketing/sparkmap-seed-to-activation — please drop any edits. also included the cohort assignment script snippet:
```python
# pseudo
def assign_cohort(user_id):
    rand = hash(user_id) % 100
    if rand < 50: return 'A'
    if rand < 80: return 'B'
    return 'control'
```
maya: nice. what about email copy cadence for webinar group? short + 2 reminders? one pre and one 1hr before
elena: yep: invite, 24h reminder, 1h reminder. post-webinar: follow-up with claim link and recommended prompt templates (auto-attach to account)
tony: I'll push two hero variations to Figma by EOD. Variant A emphasizes benchmark numbers (latency/cost benefits), Variant B is product-first (easy prompt packs)
liam: infra note — need a feature flag for promo amount per cohort. I can wire it to the promo-service; safe to deploy canary tomorrow
growth-bot: experiment created — id: exp_2026_sparkmap_01. assigned owner: elena. results endpoint: https://redwood-internal/experiments/exp_2026_sparkmap_01
sam_g: quick ask — can we also capture qualitative microfeedback in the post-webinar follow-up? 2-question poll: "Did the prompts help you get value?" yes/no + one short freeform
elena: good call. add that to the follow-up flow. ok everyone — runway: design + infra + growth setup today, go-live cohort start = 48 hours after deploy. sync at 3pm to confirm
maya: ✅ I'll handle the signup flow changes and the email cadence
tony: ✅ designs by EOD
liam: ✅ feature flag + canary ready
sam_g: ✅ I'll author the metrics spreadsheet and the follow-up poll
elena: thanks all — excited to see if this mini-loop moves the needle. :seedling:
